cli.add_maintenance_tags_help: Faka izifanekiso zokunakekela eziphakanyisiwe ezinkingeni ezitholakele.
cli.check_backlinks_help: Thola ama-athikili akhuluma ngaleli kodwa angaxhumi lapha.
cli.check_orphan_help: Hlola ukuthi i-athikili inezixhumanisi ze-wiki ezingenayo yini.
cli.check_urls_help: Yenza ukuhlola kwe-HEAD kuma-URL acashuniwe ukuze uthole izixhumanisi ezingasebenzi (kuyahamba kancane).
cli.diff_help: Bonisa umehluko (diff) phakathi kwe-wikitext ebukhoma neyasendaweni.
cli.dir_help: Skena wonke amafayela angu-*-corrected.txt nangu-*.wiki kufolda.
cli.lang_help: Ikhodi yolimi ye-UI yemilayezo ye-CLI nemibiko (ithatha indawo ye-LC_ALL/LC_MESSAGES/LANG).
cli.maintenance_tag_help: Amathegi okunakekela engeziwe; ahlukaniswe ngokhefana noma angaphindwa.
cli.offline_help: Yeqa ukuhlola kwezixhumanisi ezibomvu nokuba khona kwezigaba.
cli.quiet_help: Cindezela ukuphuma okungewona amaphutha; khipha ikhodi yokuphuma kuphela.
cli.verbose_help: Phrinta ku-stderr ukuthi yikuphi ukuhlola okusebenzayo.
cli.wikitext_file_help: Funda i-wikitext efayeleni lasendaweni esikhundleni se-API.
error.no_files_found: Akukho mafayela angu-*-corrected.txt noma angu-*.wiki atholakele ku-{path}
error.no_readable_utf8: Iphutha: akukho mafayela e-wikitext e-UTF-8 afundekayo atholakele ku-{path}
error.output_required_for_tags: Iphutha: --output-wikitext-file iyadingeka uma ufaka amathegi ngaphandle kwe-flag --dry-run.
error.target_required: Iphutha: okuhlosiwe kuyadingeka (noma sebenzisa --dir kumodi yeqoqo).
note.api_disabled_batch: qaphela: ukuhlola kwe-API kukhutshaziwe kumodi yeqoqo: {error}
note.skipping_api_checks: qaphela: ayikwazanga ukwakha iklayenti le-API; yeqa ukuhlola okusekelwe ku-API
status.no_diff: Awukho umehluko phakathi kwe-wikitext ebukhoma neyasendaweni.
warn.fix_without_output: Isexwayiso: --fix ngaphandle kwe-flag --output-wikitext-file; ukulungiswa ngeke kulondolozwe.
